papers.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
papers.abstract: Code language models need repository-level context to resolve imports, APIs, and project conventions. Existing methods inject this knowledge as long inputs (retrieved through RAG or dependency analysis) or through per-repository fine-tuning and LoRA -- costly at repository scale and brittle to evolving codebases. We introduce Code2LoRA, a hypernetwork framework that generates repository-specific LoRA adapters, effectively injecting repository knowledge with zero inference-time token overhead. Co
papers.llm_reason: Code2LoRA 用 hypernetwork 一次性生成仓库专属 LoRA 适配器——把'每仓库微调/检索增强'重构为'hypernetwork 推理时生成适配器'，零推理 token 开销且对代码演化鲁棒。直接对应 Cursor/Copilot/Devin 等编程 Agent 产品的仓库理解痛点：传统 RAG 在长仓库上噪声大、per-repo LoRA 训练成本高且每次 commit 就过时。Hypernetwork + LoRA + SE 三者首次明确耦合，immediate 价值最高。

papers.title: TailLoR: Protecting Principal Components in Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient finetuning methods based on spectral decomposition have enabled progress in Continual Learning. In this paper we introduce TailLoR, which utilizes the singular bases U and V of the pre-trained weights as a fixed reference frame to learn a low-rank update applied to the singular value matrix. A soft spectral penalty discourages updates aligned with dominant singular directions, reducing interference while routing fine-grained adaptation into the highly flexible, long-tail spec
papers.llm_reason: TailLoR 把 LoRA 的低秩更新'挂载位置'从原权重矩阵移到奇异值矩阵：保留 U/V 作为固定参考系，只学 Σ 的更新；并施加软谱惩罚抑制沿主成分方向的更新，路由适配到长尾谱。这是 PEFT × 连续学习 × 谱分解三个方向的精细化推进——核心命题是'不要碰主干'的保护主义 PEFT。与 2026 年持续学习中 catastrophic forgetting 的工程刚需对齐。

papers.title: RREDCoT: Segment-Level Reward Redistribution for Reasoning Models
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in reasoning language models have been driven by Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. Most often, these rely on the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm or modifications thereof to steer the models to produce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces. The final answer can only be verified, and the reward assigned, after the CoT trace is complete, making it a delayed reward problem. papers.llm_reason: RREDCoT 把 GRPO 在 CoT 推理微调中的延迟奖励问题（Monte Carlo 信用分配方差大）重构为'段级奖励再分配'问题：把最终答案的稀疏奖励沿 CoT 段落重新分配，对应 RL 中的 credit assignment。Hochreiter 团队加持。对当前 RLHF/GRPO 训练栈（DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3-RM、OpenAI o1 范式）有直接方法论价值，是从 token-level PPO 到 segment-level 信用分配的中间路径。

papers.title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. papers.llm_reason: TempoVLA 首次显式建模 VLA 策略的'速度可控性'：观察动作幅值天然预测精度需求，进而通过条件训练实现 transit（高速低风险）与 contact（低速高精度）阶段的速度调度。这是 VLA 走向真实部署的关键缺口——现有 VLA 只继承训练 demo 的固定速度。对 Figure/1X/Physical Intelligence/银河通用等具身智能产品的部署速度-精度权衡有直接价值。

papers.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
papers.abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid
papers.llm_reason: HANDOFF 用'互补教师蒸馏'构建人形机器人全身控制的任务空间接口：高层任务规划器输出紧凑显式指令（如目标位姿/接触点），低层 WBC 负责全身协调。把'规划-控制'接口从密集运动学参考重构为'紧凑任务空间命令'，让任务规划器更容易从语义合成命令。对 Figure/Unitree H1/Tesla Optimus 等人形机器人产品的任务规划-WBC 解耦设计有方法论价值。

papers.title: DNQ: Deep Nash Q-Network for Partially Observable n-Player Games
papers.abstract: Many real-world competitive systems require multiple decision-makers to act simultaneously under shared constraints, limited information, and repeated interaction, as in auctions, resource allocation, and security competition. papers.title: Operation-Guided Progressive Human-to-AI Text Transformation Benchmark for Multi-Granularity AI-Text Detection
papers.abstract: As AI writing assistants become increasingly integrated into real-world drafting and revision workflows, many documents are no longer purely human-written or AI-generated, but instead result from progressive human-AI co-editing. papers.title: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising an entire response in parallel. At each step, they predict tentative tokens for every masked position, committing the confident predictions to the output and discarding the unconfident ones. papers.title: Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence
papers.abstract: Training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) requires assigning credit across long sequences of computations. Standard backpropagation through time (BPTT) addresses this problem poorly: it is sequential in time, limiting parallelism, and suffers from vanishing or exploding gradients, making long-range associations difficult to learn. papers.title: Regret Minimization with Adaptive Opponents in Repeated Games
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study regret minimization in repeated games with \emph{adaptive} opponents who can respond based on histories of play.
